{{Top|leg}}
'''Flashburn''' was a term used by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] to describe the reaction in which certain [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] or [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitives]] shutdown areas of their minds in reaction to emotional trauma. With sections of their memory seemingly ceasing to exist, those who used the technique were unable to remember details about the event at the center of the trauma.

==Examples==
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Corran Horn/Legends|Corran Horn]] was flashburned when he believed his wife [[Mirax Terrik Horn|Mirax Horn]] was killed, shortly after the death of the [[Palpatine/Legends|Emperor Reborn]].
